title: Customers
description: Organisations using getproperty — open one for its subscription, invoices, devices and support.

empty.title: No customers yet
empty.body: Add the first customer with “Add customer”; check the price plans it can start on first.
empty.filteredBody: Try another name or the slug.

onboard.title: Onboard a tenant
onboard.description: The first Owner receives an SMS invitation. The tenant starts without a subscription until you subscribe it.
onboard.done: Tenant created; the Owner's invitation was sent
onboard.planHint: For reference only; the subscription sets the plan that is billed.
onboard.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It is typed back to confirm a suspension.
onboard.createdBody: The invitation went by SMS to {phone}. If it does not arrive, give the Owner this code:

overview.companyHint: As printed on the customer’s documents; the owner edits it in their console.

past_due.title: Platform invoice overdue
past_due.body: {amount} is overdue. The subscription is past due and will be suspended if it stays unpaid.

suspended.title: Suspended — read-only
suspended.body: The tenant can read and export, residents can still pay issued bills; nothing can be changed until the subscription is reinstated.

trial_ending.title: Trial ending
trial_ending.body: The trial ends on {date}; the first invoice is issued then.

no_cycle_this_month.title: No billing cycle this month
no_cycle_this_month.body: No billing cycle was opened this month. Check with the tenant whether billing is stuck.

gateways_offline.title: Gateways offline
gateways_offline.body: At least one gateway has not reported in the last 15 minutes.

overview.openInvoicesHint: {count, plural, =0 {No open invoice} other {# open invoices}}
overview.manageNoSubscription: No subscription yet — start one from the subscription page.

subscription.noneHint: Subscribe the tenant to a published plan of its type. It starts with the trial.
subscription.subscribeHint: Only published plans of the tenant's type can be sold. The trial starts now.
subscription.readOnlyBody: Suspended or cancelled: owners and staff can read and export, residents can pay issued bills, nothing is deleted.
subscription.suspendBody: {name} becomes read-only at once: no new invoices, settings or changes until reinstated. Residents can still pay issued bills.
subscription.cancelBody: The subscription ends after the current month (or the date you choose); the tenant becomes read-only and a de-install order is opened per building with platform hardware.
subscription.effectiveDateHint: Empty: the last day of the current month

pilot.noneHint: Record the pilot's terms to apply its discount and measure its KPIs.
pilot.formHint: A paid pilot: the discount applies to every platform invoice and is never 100 %.
pilot.baselineHint: The values the KPIs are compared against, as measured before go-live. Leave empty when unknown.

ai.title: AI usage
ai.hint: Per month and feature: calls, units, the plan's allowance, units beyond it and the cost to the platform at the configured unit costs.
ai.emptyHint: Meter photo and utility-bill OCR calls appear here once the tenant uses them.

lede.subscription: Plan, add-ons, trial and the history of this subscription.
lede.hardware: Platform devices rented to this customer, with term and book value.
lede.field-work: Install orders and site surveys for this customer.
lede.pilot: The pilot agreement and the KPIs it is measured by.
lede.ai-usage: What this customer’s AI features cost, by month and feature.
lede.flags: Feature flags as they apply to this customer.
lede.credentials: Payment merchants, lock vendor accounts and e-Tax accounts of this customer.
lede.support: Support access to this customer’s data — always granted by the customer and audited.
lede.view: The customer’s console, read-only, under an active support grant.
lede.buildings: Buildings the tenant owns or operates; taking over a stub and changing the operator

buildings.caption: The tenant's buildings
buildings.empty: The tenant adds its buildings in its console.
buildings.emptyJuristic: A juristic person takes over the stub its landlords created, or adds buildings in its console.
buildings.claimHint: The stub its landlords created moves to the juristic person; the landlords keep their units, leases and bills.
buildings.legalFormHint: Needed when the building has none
buildings.operatorHint: The juristic person itself, or its management company
buildings.changeHint: The data stays with the building; the new operator sees it from today.
